scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node ./scripts/write-runtime-config.mjs bundled
scripts.build:hosted: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode hosted && node ./scripts/write-runtime-config.mjs hosted
scripts.verify:fonts: node --input-type=module -e "import { existsSync, readFileSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'; import { join } from 'node:path'; const roots = [join(process.cwd(), 'public', 'fonts')]; if (process.argv.includes('--built')) roots.push(join(process.cwd(), 'dist', 'fonts')); const files = ['manrope-400.ttf', 'manrope-500.ttf', 'manrope-600.ttf', 'manrope-700.ttf', 'OFL.txt', 'README.md']; for (const root of roots) { for (const file of files) { const path = join(root, file); if (!existsSync(path) || statSync(path).size === 0) throw new Error('Missing Web font distribution file: ' + path); } const notice = readFileSync(join(root, 'OFL.txt'), 'utf8'); if (!notice.includes('SIL OPEN FONT LICENSE Version 1.1')) throw new Error('Manrope OFL notice is incomplete: ' + join(root, 'OFL.txt')); }"
scripts.verify:hosted: npm run build:hosted && PORTICO_EXPECT_RUNTIME_MODE=hosted npm run verify:bundle
